title: Pharmaceutical water systems: Purified Water (PW) | Aquemi
meta: The water grade each dosage form needs for Health Canada, FDA and EU filings, and for natural health products. One polypropylene Purified Water package; no WFI.
headline: Water matched to your dosage forms
lead: Dosage forms set the grade. We supply one Purified Water (PW) package in polypropylene, with polyvinyl chloride (PVC) pretreatment. No Water for Injection, pure steam or stainless steel systems.

items.q: Can one system supply Canada, the United States and Europe?
items.a: Yes. Where USP and Ph. Eur. differ, we design to the stricter value. The functional specification names both, and the factory acceptance test (FAT) checks both where methods allow.

items.q: Do you supply WFI or pure steam?
items.a: No: we supply a Purified Water (PW) package in polypropylene, not Water for Injection (WFI), pure steam or stainless steel.

items.q: Do natural health products need Purified Water?
items.a: Not always. GUI-0158 sets potable water as the minimum; Purified Water (PW) where your specification or a monograph calls for it.

items.q: Does a new production line mean full requalification?
items.a: Not normally. GUI-0001 asks that changes are validated before use; a risk assessment sets the scope. Usually: installation and operational qualification (IQ, OQ) of the new section, and extra sampling at its points of use.
